provider_patterns.notes: Public poster frame of an Ozolio camera, 1280x720 JPEG, Cache-Control max-age=900, CORS *, no Last-Modified. CAMERA_DOC is the camera_doc value in the owner's jwebcam embed (CID_...) or the ID in ozolio.com/explore/<ID> prefixed with CID_. No key or session.

SHARE_CODE is in the public share URL video.nest.com/live/<SHARE_CODE> (or /embedded/live/<code>); UUID is in that page's og:image. Without &public= the endpoint returns 403. No Last-Modified. The share code is a public identifier, not a login token, but Chris should decide whether it counts as a token.

About 100 cam IDs across CO/WY; the list pages https://www.coloradowebcam.net/all-webcams?page=0..4 embed each current.jpg. Last-Modified and EXIF time present; 1920x1080 or 4K. Some frozen (ouray-blowout 2023, grandlake1 2025, ouraynet-town May 2026), some 404 (silverton1, ouraynet-ridgway). Terms (/terms-use): no copying images off their servers; live display of snapshots on other sites allowed with attribution and a backlink.
Latest frame of an Ambient Weather station camera, Last-Modified present. MAC is in the owner's public page next to their ambientweather.net dashboard embed.

Stream name from liveN.brownrice.com/embed/<STREAM>. The liveN.../cam-images/<STREAM>.jpg alternative returned an HTML page for these Truckee streams, so use /snapshot/. Offline cams return a PNG 'scheduled to be offline' card (content-type image/png): treat PNG as offline.

provider_patterns.provider: GBUAPCD air-quality cameras (Owens Valley / Mono Basin)
provider_patterns.notes: Great Basin Unified APCD visibility cams (Laws North/South near Bishop, Keeler, Lee Vining Ridge, Mono East/West, Coso, NCORE, Sage Flat, Valley N/S). Paths are listed by https://www.gbuapcd.org/cgi-bin/cameraViewer?<Name>=on. Last-Modified fresh, 640x360, but night frames are 3.2 kB black, so re-check size by day before adding.
Redirects to /night/<name>.jpg after dark; no Last-Modified, overlay timestamp.
